title: Keto Spanish Tapas Board
seo_title: Keto Spanish Tapas Board: Manchego & Chorizo (4 g Net Carbs)
description: A keto Spanish tapas board for 8: Manchego, goat cheese, dry chorizo, jamón serrano, radishes, olives, roasted peppers and Marcona almonds. About 4 g net carbs.
hook: Manchego, chorizo and Marcona almonds: Spanish tapas without the bread, and still very Spanish.
why: Manchego and dry chorizo are a classic pairing: nutty sheep's milk cheese and smoky, paprika-spiced sausage. Jamón serrano or prosciutto adds a silkier meat, and goat cheese drizzled with olive oil and smoked paprika adds a creamy one.
Radishes and cucumbers do the crunching, green olives and roasted peppers add brine and sweetness, and Marcona almonds are the Spanish touch. About 4 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the goat cheese; dust it with smoked paprika.
Take out the chorizo and jamón or prosciutto; slice the chorizo.
Drizzle olive oil over the manchego. Serve.

faq.a: Dry-cured Spanish chorizo is very low in carbs, usually under 1 g per ounce. Check for added sugar.

faq.q: What goes with Manchego on a keto board?
faq.a: Chorizo, jamón, Marcona almonds, olives and roasted red peppers.
About 4 g net carbs per serving for 8.
